source:
# The Primmel grammar, in PG (Parsanol PN 1).
#
# This grammar is the deterministic surface of the Primmel language: the
# lexical structure, the declaration/statement structure, and the shared
# value forms. It mirrors spec/sources/language-v3/sections/
# 17-formal-grammar.adoc (the EBNF of record) rule for rule:
#
#   Text        ::= { Whitespace | Comment | Token }
#   Comment     ::= ('#' | '//') at a token boundary, to end of line
#   Token       ::= QuotedString | Block | BareToken
#   Declaration ::= Keyword [Identifier] Block  (plus root/version)
#
# What the grammar does not decide (per the specification's own clause):
# closed vocabularies, reference resolution, and scope discipline are
# checker matters, and per-construct facet interpretation is schema and
# binding work above the grammar (Parsanol PN 2/PN 4). The grammar
# captures each block's item stream; construct-level structure is
# materialized from the captures, not restated here.
#
# Materialization note: consumers walk the artifact's shape tree
# (PargRuntime#parseShape), which preserves the nesting of declarations
# inside blocks. The flat binding layer is not used for document-level
# materialization, because its captures are collected per name across
# nesting levels and a nested language needs the level structure.

grammar Primmel version "0.1.0" {

  # ── lexical ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  any_char = %x01-10FFFF
  ws_char = " " / "\t" / "\r" / "\n"
  optws = *ws_char
  gap = *(ws_char / comment)
  hgap = *(" " / "\t")
  comment = ("#" / "//") *(!"\n" any_char)
  escape_seq = "\\" any_char
  str_char = escape_seq / !"\"" any_char
  string = "\"" *str_char "\""
  # A colon is a normal word character (urn:oiml:pub:r:60-2:2021 is
  # ONE token, as the kernel whitespace tokenizer sees it); the entry
  # separator is the SPACE-DELIMITED colon (entry_line gap ":"),
  # never a mid-word one.
  # A hash is a normal word character mid-word (Application#data —
  # one token, as the kernel's tokenizer sees it); comments start only
  # through gap (whitespace-delimited), never inside a word.
  bare_first = !ws_char !"\"" !"{" !"}" any_char
  bare_next = !ws_char !"\"" !"{" !"}" any_char
  bare = bare_first *bare_next

  # ── document and declarations ────────────────────────────────────
  document = *(gap declaration) gap !any_char
  declaration = construct / root_decl / version_decl / include_decl / value_decl / entry_line
  include_decl = "include" gap string
  value_decl = bare gap bare gap string
  root_decl = "root" gap bare
  version_decl = "version" gap string
  # Every sequence child is captured: an uncaptured child that reaches a
  # repetition is array-valued, and a mixed sequence never merges its
  # hashes — the shape tree would flatten to leaf captures (the
  # recursive-capture finding, evidence/s2-parsanol/). `gap` carries no
  # capture and disappears from the folded sequence.
  #
  # The typed surface: a KNOWN construct dispatches to its own rule,
  # which carries the kernel parser's per-construct discipline — a
  # required-value key left bare before the block's close, and a closed
  # facet vocabulary offered an undeclared token, are parse errors (the
  # fail-closed precedent). The generic rule stays open for UNKNOWN
  # keywords (forward compatibility: the same parser reads MMEL-era and
  # Primmel-era models).
  construct = c_end_event / c_start_event / c_class / c_instance / c_approval / c_application_declaration / c_attribute_definition / c_certificate_template / c_common_test_condition / c_conformance_test / c_calculation / c_calculation_context / c_dataspace / c_declaration_gate / c_decision_rule / c_evaluation_dimensions / c_evaluation_profile / c_exclusive_gateway / c_form / c_formula_note / c_framework_document / c_governance_organ / c_identity_slot / c_informative_annex / c_lab_selection_criterion / c_link / c_participant_kind / c_part_annex / c_policy / c_promise_set / c_provision / c_process / c_sample_selection_rule / c_scheme_activity_kind / c_scheme_lifecycle / c_table / c_test_report_checklist / c_test_report_skeleton / c_verification_pathway / generic_construct
  keyword = bare
  keyword_open = !known_keyword bare
  known_keyword = ("end_event" !bare_next) / ("start_event" !bare_next) / ("approval" !bare_next) / ("application_declaration" !bare_next) / ("attribute_definition" !bare_next) / ("certificate_template" !bare_next) / ("common_test_condition" !bare_next) / ("conformance_test" !bare_next) / ("calculation" !bare_next) / ("calculation_context" !bare_next) / ("dataspace" !bare_next) / ("declaration_gate" !bare_next) / ("decision_rule" !bare_next) / ("evaluation_dimensions" !bare_next) / ("evaluation_profile" !bare_next) / ("exclusive_gateway" !bare_next) / ("class" !bare_next) / ("instance" !bare_next) / ("form" !bare_next) / ("formula_note" !bare_next) / ("framework_document" !bare_next) / ("governance_organ" !bare_next) / ("identity_slot" !bare_next) / ("informative_annex" !bare_next) / ("lab_selection_criterion" !bare_next) / ("link" !bare_next) / ("participant_kind" !bare_next) / ("part_annex" !bare_next) / ("policy" !bare_next) / ("promise_set" !bare_next) / ("provision" !bare_next) / ("process" !bare_next) / ("sample_selection_rule" !bare_next) / ("scheme_activity_kind" !bare_next) / ("scheme_lifecycle" !bare_next) / ("table" !bare_next) / ("test_report_checklist" !bare_next) / ("test_report_skeleton" !bare_next) / ("verification_pathway" !bare_next)
  # An identifier is a bare word or a quoted string ("chief verifier")
  # — SYN-02's quoted-identifier case, cross-referenced by name.
  ident = bare / string
  # the open rule: UNKNOWN keywords keep the forward-compatible surface
  generic_construct = ((keyword_open as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block as body)) as construct

  # ── the typed surface: one rule per known construct ──────────────
  # Each block_X = "{" *(gap (!bad_X X_item)) gap "}": when bad_X
  # matches (a required key bare before the close, or an undeclared
  # vocabulary token), the iteration fails, the repetition stops, and
  # the closer — unable to skip the offending text — fails the block,
  # the construct, and the document. A parent with sub-blocks
  # dispatches them FIRST (s_* rules); every other word-starting item
  # of that scope uses the sub-keyword-EXCLUDED bare (X_open), so a
  # failed sub-rule leaves no rescue — the open kwline/bare of the
  # shared stream cannot re-admit the line the sub-rule rejected.

  # ── the LutaML surface (the full flow's phase 2) ─────────────────
  # The class block accepts LUTAML'S attribute declarations beside the
  # v2 field dialect (both parse through the migration window): an
  # attribute is `attribute <name>, <Type> { <facets> }`, its facets
  # (definition, cardinality, values, modality, reference) riding the
  # body's line stream. The instance block accepts LUTAML'S
  # ASSIGNMENT FORM (`attribute = value`) beside the has-facet form.
  c_class = ((kw_class as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_class as body)) as construct
  kw_class = "class" !bare_next
  block_class = "{" *(gap (lutaml_attribute / block_item)) gap "}"
  lutaml_attribute = ((kw_lutaml_attribute as keyword) gap (attr_name as ident) gap [(attr_type as type) gap] (block as body)) as construct
  kw_lutaml_attribute = "attribute" !bare_next
  attr_name = bare / string
  attr_type = bare / string
  c_instance = ((kw_instance as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_instance as body)) as construct
  kw_instance = "instance" !bare_next
  block_instance = "{" *(gap (assign_line / block_item)) gap "}"
  assign_line = ((bare as key) hgap "=" hgap (value_run as value)) as assignment

  # events: an id and an EMPTY block, both required (the kernel's
  # "Expecting empty body")
  c_end_event = ((kw_end_event as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_empty as body)) as construct
  c_start_event = ((kw_start_event as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_empty as body)) as construct
  kw_end_event = "end_event" !bare_next
  kw_start_event = "start_event" !bare_next
  block_empty = "{" gap "}"

  c_application_declaration = ((kw_application_declaration as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_application_declaration as body)) as construct
  kw_application_declaration = "application_declaration" !bare_next
  block_application_declaration = "{" *(gap appd_item) gap "}"
  appd_item = s_app_document / appd_construct / appd_entry / appd_kwline / string / block / appd_bare
  appd_construct = ((appd_open as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block as body)) as construct
  appd_open = !(("document" !bare_next)) bare
  appd_entry = ((appd_open as key) gap ":" [gap (value_run as value)]) as entry
  appd_kwline = ((appd_open as key) gap (value_run as value)) as kwline
  appd_bare = appd_open

  s_app_document = ((kw_app_document as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_app_document as body)) as construct
  kw_app_document = "document" !bare_next
  block_app_document = "{" *(gap (!bad_app_document block_item)) gap "}"
  bad_app_document = "obligation" gap !("shall" / "should" / "may")

  c_certificate_template = ((kw_certificate_template as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_certificate_template as body)) as construct
  kw_certificate_template = "certificate_template" !bare_next
  block_certificate_template = "{" *(gap ctpl_item) gap "}"
  ctpl_item = s_characteristic / ctpl_construct / ctpl_entry / ctpl_kwline / string / block / ctpl_bare
  ctpl_construct = ((ctpl_open as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block as body)) as construct
  ctpl_open = !(("characteristic" !bare_next)) bare
  ctpl_entry = ((ctpl_open as key) gap ":" [gap (value_run as value)]) as entry
  ctpl_kwline = ((ctpl_open as key) gap (value_run as value)) as kwline
  ctpl_bare = ctpl_open

  s_characteristic = ((kw_characteristic as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_characteristic as body)) as construct
  kw_characteristic = "characteristic" !bare_next
  block_characteristic = "{" *(gap (!bad_characteristic block_item)) gap "}"
  bad_characteristic = "obligation" gap !("mandatory" / "optional")

  c_calculation = ((kw_calculation as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_calculation as body)) as construct
  kw_calculation = "calculation" !bare_next
  block_calculation = "{" *(gap (!bad_calculation calc_item)) gap "}"
  bad_calculation = "expression" gap &("}")
  calc_item = s_variant / calc_construct / calc_entry / calc_kwline / string / block / calc_bare
  calc_construct = ((calc_open as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block as body)) as construct
  calc_open = !(("variant" !bare_next)) bare
  calc_entry = ((calc_open as key) gap ":" [gap (value_run as value)]) as entry
  calc_kwline = ((calc_open as key) gap (value_run as value)) as kwline
  calc_bare = calc_open

  s_variant = ((kw_variant as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_variant as body)) as construct
  kw_variant = "variant" !bare_next
  block_variant = "{" *(gap (!bad_variant block_item)) gap "}"
  bad_variant = "type" gap !("expression" / "table_lookup" / "profile_lookup" / "pass_fail")

  c_calculation_context = ((kw_calculation_context as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_calculation_context as body)) as construct
  kw_calculation_context = "calculation_context" !bare_next
  block_calculation_context = "{" *(gap cctx_item) gap "}"
  cctx_item = s_context_field / cctx_construct / cctx_entry / cctx_kwline / string / block / cctx_bare
  cctx_construct = ((cctx_open as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block as body)) as construct
  cctx_open = !(("field" !bare_next)) bare
  cctx_entry = ((cctx_open as key) gap ":" [gap (value_run as value)]) as entry
  cctx_kwline = ((cctx_open as key) gap (value_run as value)) as kwline
  cctx_bare = cctx_open

  s_context_field = ((kw_context_field as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_context_field as body)) as construct
  kw_context_field = "field" !bare_next
  block_context_field = "{" *(gap (!bad_context_field block_item)) gap "}"
  bad_context_field = "source" gap &("}")

  c_dataspace = ((kw_dataspace as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_dataspace as body)) as construct
  kw_dataspace = "dataspace" !bare_next
  block_dataspace = "{" *(gap (!bad_dataspace ds_item)) gap "}"
  bad_dataspace = "name" gap &("}")
  ds_item = s_trust_anchor / ds_construct / ds_entry / ds_kwline / string / block / ds_bare
  ds_construct = ((ds_open as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block as body)) as construct
  ds_open = !(("trust_anchor" !bare_next)) bare
  ds_entry = ((ds_open as key) gap ":" [gap (value_run as value)]) as entry
  ds_kwline = ((ds_open as key) gap (value_run as value)) as kwline
  ds_bare = ds_open

  s_trust_anchor = ((kw_trust_anchor as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_trust_anchor as body)) as construct
  kw_trust_anchor = "trust_anchor" !bare_next
  block_trust_anchor = "{" *(gap (!bad_trust_anchor block_item)) gap "}"
  bad_trust_anchor = "trust_ref" gap &("}")

  c_evaluation_dimensions = ((kw_evaluation_dimensions as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_evaluation_dimensions as body)) as construct
  kw_evaluation_dimensions = "evaluation_dimensions" !bare_next
  block_evaluation_dimensions = "{" *(gap edim_item) gap "}"
  edim_item = s_dimension_field / edim_construct / edim_entry / edim_kwline / string / block / edim_bare
  edim_construct = ((edim_open as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block as body)) as construct
  edim_open = !(("field" !bare_next)) bare
  edim_entry = ((edim_open as key) gap ":" [gap (value_run as value)]) as entry
  edim_kwline = ((edim_open as key) gap (value_run as value)) as kwline
  edim_bare = edim_open

  s_dimension_field = ((kw_dimension_field as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_dimension_field as body)) as construct
  kw_dimension_field = "field" !bare_next
  block_dimension_field = "{" *(gap (!bad_dimension_field block_item)) gap "}"
  bad_dimension_field = "type" gap !("integer" / "number" / "string" / "text" / "boolean" / "date")

  c_identity_slot = ((kw_identity_slot as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_identity_slot as body)) as construct
  kw_identity_slot = "identity_slot" !bare_next
  block_identity_slot = "{" *(gap islot_item) gap "}"
  islot_item = s_presentation / islot_construct / islot_entry / islot_kwline / string / block / islot_bare
  islot_construct = ((islot_open as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block as body)) as construct
  islot_open = !(("presentation" !bare_next)) bare
  islot_entry = ((islot_open as key) gap ":" [gap (value_run as value)]) as entry
  islot_kwline = ((islot_open as key) gap (value_run as value)) as kwline
  islot_bare = islot_open

  # the presentation channels are enumerated positively — an undeclared
  # channel fails the block outright
  s_presentation = ((("presentation" !bare_next) as keyword) gap (block_presentation as body)) as construct
  block_presentation = "{" *(gap presentation_channel) gap "}"
  presentation_channel = "marked-on-instrument" / "accompanying-document"

  c_informative_annex = ((kw_informative_annex as keyword) gap [(ident as ident) gap] (block_informative_annex as body)) as construct
  kw_informative_annex = "informative_annex" !bare_next
  block_informative_annex = "{" *(gap annex_item) gap "}"
  annex_item = s_annex_document / annex_construct / annex_entry / annex_kwline / string / block / annex_bare
